pharma.title: Sildenafil, Tadalafil Under Scanner as DCGI Launches Crackdown on Illegal Sexual Enhancement Drug Sales
pharma.summary: The Drugs Controller General of India (DCGI) has launched a nationwide crackdown on the unauthorized and illegal sale of sexual enhancement drugs, specifically targeting Sildenafil and Tadalafil.

pharma.title: Eli Lilly pauses obesity awareness campaign in India after drug regulator warning
pharma.summary: Pharma giant Eli Lilly has halted its obesity awareness campaign in India following regulatory warnings and scrutiny from the Indian drugs regulator regarding direct-to-consumer promotion rules.

pharma.title: Over 12 lakh chemists call nationwide strike on May 20
pharma.summary: More than 1.2 million chemists across India have announced a nationwide strike scheduled for May 20 to highlight ongoing grievances and policy issues affecting retail pharmacy operations.

pharma.title: Parexel acquires Vitrana to enhance AI tools
pharma.summary: Global clinical research organization Parexel has acquired Vitrana to integrate advanced artificial intelligence capabilities into its clinical trial and drug development services.

national.title: PM Modi reiterates call for work from home, avoid buying gold 'in time of global crisis'
national.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi renewed appeals encouraging corporate work-from-home models and advising citizens to refrain from panic gold buying during ongoing global geopolitical crises.

national.title: Four-day work week with 3 days off? Conditions under new labour codes
national.summary: Discussions surrounding the new labor codes highlight guidelines allowing a flexible four-day work week with three days off, provided workers meet required weekly hour thresholds.

national.title: An Unusual Heat Wave Strains the World’s Most Populous Country
national.summary: An intense and unseasonal heatwave has gripped large parts of India, placing extreme pressure on public health systems, energy grids, and agricultural sectors.

international.title: UAE’s secret attack on Iran risks drawing Gulf states into the war
international.summary: Reports of covert military action involving the UAE against Iranian targets have heightened regional tension, risking broader conflict across the Gulf region.

international.title: Some 200 Ethiopians sentenced to death in Saudi Arabia
international.summary: Saudi Arabian courts have sentenced approximately 200 Ethiopian nationals to death, raising major human rights concerns internationally.

international.title: Can't intimidate us with barbed wire, says Bangladesh, puts border force on alert
international.summary: Bangladesh has placed its border security forces on high alert, issuing statements opposing unilateral border fencing and barbed wire installations.

economy.title: 'Permitted unless prohibited': NITI Aayog's next-gen reforms guidebook
economy.summary: NITI Aayog has unveiled a regulatory framework guidebook titled 'Permitted unless prohibited' aimed at simplifying compliance and fostering business innovation.

economy.title: ‘No more business as usual’: Piyush Goyal’s wake-up call to Indian industry amid Gulf crisis
economy.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged Indian exporters and industries to adapt to shifting trade dynamics and supply chain disruptions caused by escalating tension in the Gulf region.

economy.title: Indian economy has continued to show resilience amid global challenges, says Commerce Minister
economy.summary: Official statements from the Commerce Ministry reaffirmed that India's economic growth momentum remains resilient despite macroeconomic headwinds and global conflict.

science.title: CSIR transfers 13 indigenous building technologies to industry
science.summary: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) officially transferred 13 low-cost, eco-friendly indigenous construction technologies to private industry partners.

science.title: C-CAMP teams up with global tech firm to make drug testing more accessible
science.summary: The Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP) partnered with an international technology firm to streamline and expand access to advanced bio-testing platforms.

science.title: India unveils digital health aggregator platform
science.summary: India launched a unified digital health aggregator platform designed to integrate public health databases, tele-consultation services, and digital record repositories.

environment.title: IMD launches two AI-enabled advanced weather forecast systems
environment.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) introduced two artificial intelligence-driven weather forecasting systems to enhance micro-level climate and severe weather predictions.

environment.title: The strategic imperative of India’s climate finance taxonomy
environment.summary: Experts highlighted the urgency of establishing an official green taxonomy in India to standardise sustainable investments and attract international climate finance.

sports.title: Indian sports wrap: Lakshay enters gold-medal bout at Asian Boxing U-17 Championships
sports.summary: Indian boxer Lakshay advanced to the final gold-medal bout at the Asian Boxing U-17 Championships following a dominant semifinal victory.

sports.title: IBL isn’t chasing cricket, it's eyeing 'sporting entertainment' for next generation of fans
sports.summary: The Indian Bowling League (IBL) outlined its long-term strategy to build a distinct non-cricket sports entertainment franchise model tailored for youth audiences.

awards_honours.title: President Murmu honours nursing personnel with National Florence Nightingale Awards 2026
awards_honours.summary: President Droupadi Murmu presented the National Florence Nightingale Awards 2026 to exemplary nursing professionals for their selfless service and healthcare contribution.

awards_honours.title: NLCIL CMD Prasanna Kumar Motupalli Wins Leadership Excellence Award 2025-26
awards_honours.summary: Prasanna Kumar Motupalli, Chairman and Managing Director of NLC India Limited, was awarded the prestigious Leadership Excellence Award 2025-26 for operational excellence in the public sector.

defence.title: India to project power across Indo-Pacific and beyond by 2047: Defence Secy
defence.summary: The Defence Secretary highlighted India's strategic roadmap aimed at developing long-range naval and aerospace capabilities to project defense capabilities across the Indo-Pacific region by 2047.

defence.title: India ready to counter any cross-border misadventure: Navy chief designate
defence.summary: India's Navy Chief Designate reiterated maritime security readiness to protect sovereign sea lanes and deter aggression along critical oceanic borders.

schemes_appointments.title: Indian Army launches community radio 'Sangam 88.8' to empower youth in Rajouri border area
schemes_appointments.summary: The Indian Army established a community radio station named 'Sangam 88.8' in the Rajouri sector of Jammu and Kashmir to inform and empower local border youth.

schemes_appointments.title: Meghalaya to launch four flagship skilling schemes at Skillerate 2026 in Shillong
schemes_appointments.summary: The Meghalaya state government announced four new flagship youth skill development programs scheduled to launch during the Skillerate 2026 summit in Shillong.

schemes_appointments.title: Sameep Shastri set to take over as Chairman of BRICS Chamber
schemes_appointments.summary: Sameep Shastri has been appointed as the incoming Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce and Industry to lead trade expansion initiatives across member nations.

important_days.title: May 12, 2026: International Nurses Day observed globally
important_days.summary: International Nurses Day was commemorated worldwide on May 12, marking the birth anniversary of Florence Nightingale and recognizing the contributions of nurses.

important_days.title: International ME/CFS Awareness Day observed on May 12
important_days.summary: May 12 was observed as International Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) Awareness Day to promote medical research and public understanding.

mcqs.q: Which global pharmaceutical company paused its obesity awareness campaign in India following scrutiny by the national drug regulator in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Eli Lilly paused its obesity awareness campaign in India after receiving regulatory scrutiny and warnings regarding compliance with pharmaceutical marketing rules.

mcqs.q: What is the name of the regulatory reforms guidebook recently released by NITI Aayog?
mcqs.explanation: NITI Aayog launched its next-generation reform guidebook titled 'Permitted unless prohibited' to reduce regulatory friction for businesses.

mcqs.q: Which organization transferred 13 indigenous building technologies to industry partners in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) transferred 13 indigenous construction and building technologies to commercial industry players.

mcqs.q: The Indian Army launched the community radio station 'Sangam 88.8' to empower local youth in which region?
mcqs.explanation: The Indian Army launched community radio 'Sangam 88.8' in the Rajouri border area of Jammu & Kashmir to engage and empower youth.

mcqs.q: International Nurses Day is observed annually on which date?
mcqs.explanation: International Nurses Day is celebrated around the world every year on May 12, commemorating the birth anniversary of Florence Nightingale.
